newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Ceval still a sell.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Ceval still a sell.

text.p: -- Credit Lyonnais Securities said it was maintaining its sell rating for Brazilian food processor Ceval's preferred share but lowering its 1996, 1997 and 1998 net profit forecasts for the firm.
-- "Higher debt levels and lower contribution from interest rate arbitrage are expected to erode anticipated improvements at the operating line," the investment bank said in a report.
-- It cut its net profit forecast by 84 percent to 4.2 million reais for 1996, by 53 percent to 22.4 million reais for 1997 and by 21 percent to 46.4 million reais by 1998, the bank said.
-- Ceval's preferred was ended flat at 10.20 reais Wednesday on the Sao Paulo bourse.
